title: %divide — quotient of two numbers
purpose: Divide the first number by the second.
input:
a = #7
b = #2
zero = #0
ten = ##10
two = ##2
negTen = ##-10
notes: Division always yields a number type (#), reflecting the possibility of a decimal result.
A zero divisor yields null (~) rather than an error; use %safeDivide to supply a fallback.

avoid.why: two operands are required; one operand raises a verb-arity error
